list.arch:
<tree>
                    <field name="name" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="code" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="transport_mode_id" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="note"/>
                    <field name="active" modifiers="{"column_invisible": true}"/>
                </tree>

form.arch:
<form>
                    <sheet>
                        <group>
                            <field name="name" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                            <field name="code" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                            <field name="transport_mode_id" modifiers="{"required": true}" can_create="false" can_write="false"/>
                            <field name="note"/>
                            <field name="active" modifiers="{"invisible": true}"/>
                        </group>
                    </sheet>
                </form>

search.arch:
<search>
                    <field name="name"/>
                    <field name="code"/>
                    <field name="transport_mode_id"/>
                    <field name="note"/>
                    <filter name="ftr_archived" string="Archived" domain="[('active', '=', False)]"/>
                </search>
